notes: Dev ABox revision whose edited relation carries a subproperty (clipping_of is a subproperty of derived_from). The new source keeps the same clipped end ('-phone'), so the edit is formally possible and does not give itself away. Derived: two compositions about the new value (what kind of thing a saxophone is; its decade) and one question that uses the subproperty step and then transitivity of derived_from: whether 'phone' derives from a word that is itself derived from a person's surname (saxophone, from Sax's surname). The meaning of 'phone' (a telephone) is not edited, only its etymology, so the questions ask about the word the clipping comes from, never about what a phone is. Unrelated near asks another clipping (fridge); its answer differs from 'saxophone'. Related (one question): is 'phone' derived from 'telephone' (stored, 'short for telephone'; subproperty of clipping_of); caveat: derived_from is many-valued and transitive, so a model can keep 'phone is derived from telephone' after the edit from background belief, and the formal check cannot show the 'no'.
